title: Dribble, Jump-Stop, Pivot Series
description: Players dribble to a spot, jump-stop on balance, pivot to face a partner and pass — the fundamental sequence behind every legal stop with the ball.

content.objective: Finish a dribble with a balanced two-foot stop, protect the ball with a pivot and deliver an accurate pass.
content.setup: Partners stand six metres apart with a cone between them.
instructions: Dribble from your spot to the cone.
Jump-stop on both feet at the cone, catching the ball at the hip.
Front pivot 180 degrees to face your partner.
Pass to your partner (chest or bounce).
coachingPoints: Land on both feet at once, knees bent.
Pick one pivot foot and keep it glued down.
Chin the ball (elbows out) while pivoting.
commonMistakes: Landing on one foot then the other (travel).
Lifting the pivot foot during the turn.
content.safety: Pairs spaced so passes do not cross other pairs' lanes.
progressions: Reverse pivot instead of front pivot.
Add a partner defending the pass after the pivot.
regressions: Walk to the cone with a dribble.
Catch without a pivot, then pass.
variations: Stride stop instead of jump stop.
Pivot, fake a pass, then pass.
successCriteria: Ten stops in a row with no travel.
Every pass reaches the partner's chest.
content.gameApplication: Most young-player travels happen at the end of a dribble; a reliable stop and pivot keeps possession.
